title: Pahalgam Horror Haunts J&K Again: Head Constable Shot Dead In Broad-Daylight Terror Attack In Anantnag; TRF Claims Responsibility
description: Terrorists opened fire on a police party at Kotwal Gali in Anantnag's Lal Chowk area on Wednesday afternoon (~12:35 PM), killing Head Constable Ashiq Hussain Quraishi of the IR-3rd Battalion on the spot.
